guides.favoredWhen: His own pick into her. Run Bone Plating, bait E, and end lanes before E-poke grinds you.

keyTips.text: Run Bone Plating: it blunts her opener.
Bait her E, then combo: no chain means no answer.

tips.text: Take TP unless your jungle ganks a lot: the lane is long.
Pop Bone Plating with a long Q as she last-hits, then Q+W Electrocute.
Desync backs: reset on your terms, not hers.
Long laning means getting E-poked down: close before the grind.
Plating plus E-bait plus early close: the LeBlanc who never chains you never wins.

sources.author: pumpTM
sources.rankClaim: Rank 1 LeBlanc, 2941LP Challenger (title); Challenger (profile badge) · LeBlanc main

guides.favoredWhen: Even. Deny her all-ins with W, land the second E hit, and punish her misplaces.

keyTips.text: Even lane: she all-ins your misplaces, so do not misplace.
Never let her engage for free: W the spot she wants.
Land the second E hit: the return is the damage.

tips.text: Poke, do not brawl: your rays out-trade her Qs.
Hold W for her engage: stunned Akali is dead Akali.
She dodges with shroud and MS: hold spells for the reappear.
Track shroud cooldown (about {cd:84:W}): no shroud means no escape for her.
Misplaces denied plus W held: the Akali who never reaches you never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: You win trades at nearly every stage. Force them, and respect only her gank setup.

keyTips.text: You win trades at nearly every stage: force them.
Her only real threat is gank setup after 6: play around vision and your Flash.
Your E defines windows (about {cd:112:E}): obvious Es get dodged, so vary them.

tips.text: Throw non-obvious Es: she dodges telegraphed casts with W.
Keep the wave pushed: her threat is Charm into ganks, not the raw 1v1.
After 6, track her jungler: gank setup is her whole comeback.
Keep forcing trades: your stage never ends.
Trades forced plus ganks denied: the Ahri who never sets up never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: You are favoured in the raw 1v1. Win the skillshot check, survive ganks, and take 2v2s.

keyTips.text: You are favoured in the raw 1v1: press your range edge.
It is a skillshot check: movement and landing spells decide it.
Take Second Wind: her poke war is answered in sustain.

tips.text: Move between every cast: standing still loses her check.
Land your E and Q: her check fails when yours connect.
You are very gankable: wards before greed.
Favour 2v2 and 3v3 skirmishes: with help you outfight her.
Favoured 1v1 plus skirmish edge: Second Wind through the lane, numbers for the fight.

sources.author: Trisend3
sources.rankClaim: Challenger (title and profile badge) · Syndra main

guides.favoredWhen: Even. Keep range on his shadows, answer jumps with your field, and punish spent Ws.

keyTips.text: Even skill lane: respect the all-in, win the poke.
When his shadow comes in, answer with your field: Gravity Field is your disengage.
He plays for the all-in: never stand where his shadows land.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: Keep him at E range: your poke is free, his engage is not.
Track his W cooldown: shadow-down is your poke window.
Field his shadow engage: W under yourself when he commits.
Punish spent shadows: no W means a free E.
Death Mark lands him behind you: pre-aim W behind yourself when he ults.
Range held plus field ready: the Zed who never reaches you never wins.

keyTips.text: Play as the evolution scaler: prioritize safe last hits early and use takedowns to reach ability upgrades sooner.
Trade Q for its shield in safer short exchanges, or poke and farm from range with E when ranged opponents make Q trades hard.
Evolve Q for movement speed when survival and disengage matter most, and E for poke and waveclear when the lane needs control and room to rotate.

tips.text: Use W to interrupt an approach or cover an escape, and to set up a gank or catch an exposed target.
Against strong early all-in opponents, skip forcing level-two or level-three trades and wait for a safer opening or jungler help.
Treat Aery as the aggressive option for extra damage and shielding, and First Strike as the scaling pick that adds value into tankier teams.
Treat the post-lane stretch from around minute ten onward as Viktor's first stronger phase, once evolutions and early sustain items come online.
Poke from range without offering an easy return trade, tracking both junglers before setting up a play.
Pair the stronger E poke and waveclear with safer pushes and rotations, while the evolved Q movement covers positioning against divers.

Recall into Lost Chapter first, then follow the normal route of Blackfire Torch, boots, Liandry's Torment, Hextech Rocketbelt, Zhonya's Hourglass, Void Staff, and Rabadon's Deathcap; take the Rod of Ages, Rocketbelt, Void Staff, Zhonya's, Rabadon's defensive line or the Lich Bane and Shadowflame burst line by game.
Play from the back line in developing fights, keeping opponents at range with repeated poke and never stepping forward for damage that exposes Viktor to a dive.
Use Teleport to collect a side wave and rejoin for the objective when the team groups elsewhere.
Treat Q movement and the W stun as limited escape tools: when both are unavailable, Viktor is especially vulnerable to champions who can reach him.
Hold the ultimate to interrupt channeled casts, including Katarina's Death Lotus, rather than spending it only for damage.

itemization.text: Favor Lucidity boots for the cooldown-oriented longer trades and repeated Q use, Sorcerer's Shoes as the general damage option, Plated Steelcaps into physical damage pressure, Mercury's Treads into magic damage and crowd control, and Swifties when extra movement is needed.
